# vector ref

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:vectorRef`](gmeow-vectorRef.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/vectorRef>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

A dereferenceable locator for the vector payload (an object-store key, an index slot). The vector lives outside the graph by reference (P12); the graph holds the audit trail, not the floats.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) -> [`xsd:anyURI`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:vectorRef`](gmeow-vectorRef.md) from [`gmeow:Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) to [`xsd:anyURI`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
